new_features.title: AI-powered address validation with real-time correction
new_features.description: Validate each address in real time as you enter it. The system enriches it with postal authority data and surfaces ranked correction suggestions with confidence scores before submission. Supports addresses across 157 countries using USPS, Royal Mail, and UPU postal authority data.

enhancements.title: Export compliance results as CSV or PDF
enhancements.description: Adds an Export Results button to the Compliance screen. Users can download compliance check results in CSV or PDF format, including shipment ID, destination country, contents, data type, and compliance status.

enhancements.title: Validation History table now supports CSV export
enhancements.description: The Validation History table can now be exported to CSV format. Operations teams can share audit records without requiring application login.

enhancements.title: Batch validation now supports up to 10,000 records per job
enhancements.description: Increased batch size limit from 5,000 to 10,000 records per validation job. Reduces turnaround time for large datasets.

bug_fixes.title: Dashboard metrics not updating in real time
bug_fixes.summary: Three KPI metrics showed values up to 24 hours old regardless of selected date range.
bug_fixes.resolution: All three metrics now refresh on every page load and update in the background every 15 minutes. EU shipment data is included in Compliance Pass calculations.

bug_fixes.title: Compliance report excluding EU shipments
bug_fixes.summary: The Compliance Passes metric excluded all shipments destined for EU countries, causing reported compliance percentage to be higher than actual rate.
bug_fixes.resolution: EU shipment records are now included in all compliance calculations and exports.

known_issues.title: Bulk validation timeout on files over 50,000 rows
known_issues.description: Jobs containing more than 50,000 address records may time out after 30 minutes without completing.
known_issues.workaround: Split large files into multiple jobs of 40,000 records or fewer.

known_issues.title: Incomplete compliance checks for China shipments
known_issues.description: Compliance checks for shipments to China sometimes return incomplete results because certain technology-related rules are not fully mapped in the system. Users may see a Limited status for China shipments.
known_issues.workaround: Review China shipment compliance results manually for sensitive product categories.
